assumptions: The requested weekly total requires the unstated time-unit conversion from one week to seven days, which F3-v1 does not permit inventing.
The requested percentage requires converting between hours and minutes, but the source does not state that conversion and F3-v1 does not permit inventing it.

f3_program: collection("company.employees", "employee", "company", source("A company has 1000 employees"))
observe(at("company.employees.count", "initial"), 1000, "count", source("A company has 1000 employees"))
observe(at("company.layoffs.round_count", "planned"), 3, "count", source("There will be three rounds of layoffs"))

remove("layoff_round_1", "company", at("company.employees.count", "current"), fraction(at("company.employees.count", "current"), 10, 100), source("For each round of layoff, 10% of the remaining employees will be laid off"))

remove("layoff_round_2", "company", at("company.employees.count", "current"), fraction(at("company.employees.count", "current"), 10, 100), source("For each round of layoff, 10% of the remaining employees will be laid off"))

remove("layoff_round_3", "company", at("company.employees.count", "current"), fraction(at("company.employees.count", "current"), 10, 100), source("For each round of layoff, 10% of the remaining employees will be laid off"))
query("absolute_difference", at("company.employees.count", "initial"), at("company.employees.count", "current"))
observe(at("heating_plant.fuel_consumption.duration", "given_period"), 21, "hour", source("In 21 hours"))
observe(at("heating_plant.fuel_consumed.volume", "given_period"), 7, "liter", source("a heating plant consumes 7 liters of fuel"))

rate_relation(at("heating_plant.fuel_consumed.volume", "given_period"), "heating_plant.fuel_consumption.rate", at("heating_plant.fuel_consumption.duration", "given_period"), source("In 21 hours, a heating plant consumes 7 liters of fuel"))
observe(at("heating_plant.fuel_consumption.duration", "requested_period"), 90, "hour", source("in 90 hours"))
query("value", at("heating_plant.fuel_consumed.volume", "requested_period"))

collection("convenience_store.chip_bag_sales.weekly", "weekly_chip_bag_sale", "convenience_store", source("In the first week, 15 bags of chips were sold. In the second week, thrice as many bags of chips were sold. There was an equal number of chips sold in the third and fourth week."))
member("convenience_store.chip_bag_sales.weekly", "convenience_store.chip_bag_sales.first_week.count", source("In the first week, 15 bags of chips were sold"))
member("convenience_store.chip_bag_sales.weekly", "convenience_store.chip_bag_sales.second_week.count", source("In the second week, thrice as many bags of chips were sold"))
member("convenience_store.chip_bag_sales.weekly", "convenience_store.chip_bag_sales.third_week.count", source("There was an equal number of chips sold in the third and fourth week"))
member("convenience_store.chip_bag_sales.weekly", "convenience_store.chip_bag_sales.fourth_week.count", source("There was an equal number of chips sold in the third and fourth week"))
observe(at("convenience_store.chip_bag_sales.total.count", "month"), 100, "count", source("A convenience store sold 100 bags of chips in a month"))
observe(at("convenience_store.chip_bag_sales.first_week.count", "first_week"), 15, "count", source("In the first week, 15 bags of chips were sold"))

multiple(at("convenience_store.chip_bag_sales.second_week.count", "second_week"), at("convenience_store.chip_bag_sales.first_week.count", "first_week"), 3, source("In the second week, thrice as many bags of chips were sold"))

same(at("convenience_store.chip_bag_sales.third_week.count", "third_week"), at("convenience_store.chip_bag_sales.fourth_week.count", "fourth_week"), source("There was an equal number of chips sold in the third and fourth week"))

partition("convenience_store.chip_bag_sales.weekly", at("convenience_store.chip_bag_sales.total.count", "month"), source("A convenience store sold 100 bags of chips in a month. In the first week, 15 bags of chips were sold. In the second week, thrice as many bags of chips were sold. There was an equal number of chips sold in the third and fourth week."))
query("value", at("convenience_store.chip_bag_sales.third_week.count", "third_week"))
